description: This file is a script for cleaning up orphaned content files in a roadmap project. It fetches roadmap data, identifies orphaned files based on node IDs and slugs, and deletes or renames them accordingly. It also generates a summary report of the cleanup process.

methods.name: fetchRoadmapJson
methods.description: Fetches roadmap JSON data from API or local fallback.

methods.name: isEditorRoadmap
methods.description: Checks if a roadmap is editor-rendered based on its markdown front matter.

methods.name: getEditorRoadmapSlugs
methods.description: Retrieves slugs of all editor-rendered roadmaps.

methods.name: parseContentFilename
methods.description: Parses filename to extract slug and node ID.

methods.name: cleanupRoadmap
methods.description: Main function to identify and clean orphaned content files for a given roadmap.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function coordinating cleanup for specified or all roadmaps.
